label: Strategies
heading: Where we invest.
lede: We stay in asset types where our construction and management teams give us a real edge.

strategies.title: Value-add multifamily
strategies.body: Class B and C apartment communities with dated interiors, below-market rents or under-managed operations.

strategies.title: Build-to-rent & ground-up
strategies.body: New rental communities and townhomes where building it ourselves creates a cost advantage over buying finished product.
bullets: Built by our own construction team

strategies.title: Single-family rentals
strategies.body: Renovated single-family homes managed in groups, so they run with the discipline of a small apartment community.

vehicles.name: Single-asset offerings
vehicles.body: Invest in one property at a time. Review each business plan and choose the deals that fit you.

vehicles.name: Diversified funds
vehicles.body: One commitment spread across several assets, markets and strategies, deployed by our team.
